verdict.rationale: Datalab documents an official Python SDK covering conversion, pipelines, structured extraction, form filling, and file management, with dedicated SDK sub-pages and a bundled CLI. A version policy also extends backwards-compatibility guarantees to the SDK. missing for 10: evidence of official SDKs beyond Python (e.g. TypeScript/JS), independent or hands-on corroboration of the SDK.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: The Datalab Python SDK provides a simple interface for document conversion, pipelines, structured extraction, form filling, and file management.
The SDK provides a simple interface to convert documents to Markdown, HTML, JSON, or chunks.
Fill PDF and image forms with structured field data using the Datalab SDK.
we will not introduce breaking changes for top-level versions
